correctness.rationale: Exact Bernstein beta moments give the shifted Legendre modes of degrees 0, 1, 2 with eigenvalues 1, 1/2, 1/10; these exhaust the degree-two range. With u=2x−1 and v=2y−1 the power kernel is 1+3·2^(-t)uv+(5/4)10^(-t)(3u²−1)(3v²−1). A negative value anywhere, including the boundary, gives negative output on a positive-measure interval for a nonnegative input supported in a nearby interval, so continuity really makes the pointwise minimum decisive. At fixed w=|uv|, opposite signs and u²+v²≤1+w² give the exact lower envelope 1−3·2^(-t)w+(5/2)10^(-t)(3w²−1), attained at u=1,v=−w. Its vertex is w=5^(t−1), yielding the first formula for t≤1 and the endpoint formula for t≥1. The first branch is strictly concave, negative at 0, zero at 1 with negative derivative there, so it has precisely one internal root. The second is zero at 1, has negative derivative there, and its derivative changes sign once from negative to positive; its limit is 1, yielding exactly one later root. Degree one has eigenvalues 1 and 1/3, so its kernel minimum is 1−3^(1−t), with no reentry. Zero eigenvalues do not contribute at any t>0.
residual_risks: The root approximations are supporting diagnostics; strict derivative and convexity arguments establish the exact all-t classification. No positivity statement here for arbitrary Jacobi weight, higher degree, or semigroup continuity at t=0 on all of L².

broader_coverage.reasoning: The finite matrix theorem quantifies over entrywise nonnegative 3×3 matrices, not arbitrary matrix elements of a rank-three integral operator evaluated with a continuum of positive tests. Sampling the kernel and powering the resulting 3×3 matrix need not give sampled values of the powered operator. General positive Bernstein kernels do not by themselves dominate a fixed-degree real-power sign classification.

value.rationale: The natural quadratic Markov averaging kernel gives a sharp counterexample to monotone persistence of order positivity along its canonical real spectral powers after t=1. Exact witnesses and thresholds locate both failure and recovery, and the degree-one comparison shows the low-degree boundary within the family. This distinction between order positivity and positive semidefiniteness is directly relevant to positive interpolation of a Markov iterate.
residual_risks: This is a classification of the canonical spectral interpolation, not an obstruction to every possible embedding or a claim about general degree.
